entries.en: to thread (as a needle or beads); to pierce; to string

entries.zh: 穿针；把线穿过针眼（针头）
entries.en: to thread the needle; to pass the thread through the needle's eye
to rinse out (as jugs or pitchers); to swill vessels
entries.notes: H 栏字形存疑（溫/盪）；依 L'enjaguar'（涮洗）与 R 栏对音相合，定为'盪（荡洗）'义而非'溫（加温）'。

entries.en: mutually; each other; to interlink, entwine (enlazar)
entries.notes: 释义据 H'互'；L'enlazar'（连接、纠结）与之呼应，M/R 栏音写各有存疑（ü/i、h/x）。

entries.en: to intersect, cross; to interlace; to associate with
entries.notes: R 栏对音'hiòng guiàn'与 H/M'相交'不合且存疑（h/s）；释义据 H/M 两栏。

entries.en: to pave with bricks or flagstones; to floor

entries.zh: 铺开；摊开、铺满（砖石铺地）
entries.en: to spread out; to lay bricks or tiles over (a surface)
entries.notes: R 栏音写存疑（g/p）；L 栏'Vals, moappes'难解；释义据 H/M'铺开'。

entries.zh: 丝线、丝帛（繒）；绷紧上机（织造用语）
entries.en: silk thread; silk fabric; to string or dress the thread on the loom
entries.notes: L 栏 Enlisar（穿综绷线）罕见且缩写 p̃oser 展开存疑；字义据 H'繒'，织造语境据 L。
M 栏空缺；L 栏为页边注（说明'仇'原写于页边、本位应在前条 dios 之后），非定义文本；释义据 H'仇'。
M 栏空缺；L 栏为页边注续文'por ser aquel su lugar'；释义据 H'讎'。

M/R 栏空缺；据 H'冤家'及'仇'词族语境释义，L 栏页边注谓该词已在他处 C 部收录。
M/R 栏空缺；据 H'冤仇'复合词义释义，L 栏为页边注续文。
